description: This file defines an authentication service class for a Flutter app using Supabase as backend. It provides methods for sign-in, sign-up, sign-out, fetching current user info, and role management.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: A service class encapsulating authentication functionalities using Supabase client, including sign-in, sign-up, sign-out, and user role management.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Signs in a user with email and password using Supabase backend.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and role; optionally redirects email confirmation based on environment variable.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Getter that returns the currently authenticated user, or null if none.

methods.name: currentRole
methods.description: Retrieves the role of the current user from metadata or defaults to 'patient'.

methods.name: fetchRoleFromProfiles
methods.description: Fetches user role from the 'profiles' table by user ID.

methods.name: buildAppUser
methods.description: Constructs an AppUser instance for the current user, attempting to resolve role from metadata and profiles.
